function.arguments: {"finding": "The email channel is not randomly assigned — it was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers (loyal and returning), who are more likely to spend more. The paid_search channel is likely more diverse in customer segment. Therefore, any raw comparison of average revenue between channels is confounded by customer segment. The email channel may appear to have higher revenue not because of the campaign, but because of who was targeted.", "implication": "We cannot report a raw difference in average revenue between channels. function.name: note_finding
